statement: proceed. Execute at most three more council passes. Make bounded changes. When asked, stop after the third council. Unit of work
scope: Apply the bounded post-round2 document correction proposal; fresh delta-first/full conditional-directive council after each correction within this loop. No product construction or new effects.
stop_when: All three seats VERIFIED, zero mandatory findings and coverage/overall>=9.5, or after the third additional council pass, whichever is first. No fourth additional pass or replacement bypass.
frozen_parents: Approved REM, compatibility annex, impact assessment, test-migration/architecture/guide plans and all product/test/config/metadata/lock/store bytes remain unchanged.
policy_disposition: This explicit three-pass authorization bounds continued document remediation despite prior unsuccessful councils; stop at its cap rather than infer any further cycle.
